explication: Unleash is a feature-management service: operators configure flags and governance in the web console, while SDK applications request evaluated flag data from the server. The sampled frontend shows route and plan filtering, administrative areas, API-token and service-account workflows, signal queries, and persistent UI preferences. Backend implementation details were not sampled beyond src/server.ts, so those relationships are limited to README-documented SDK/API behavior and directly observed frontend fetches.
